info.name: Umari OS API
info.description:
Postman collection for Umarí OS API.

This collection uses variables and does not store real credentials or tokens. Set local values in Postman before running the requests.

request.description:
This is a GET request and it is used to "get" data from an endpoint. There is no request body for a GET request, but you can use query parameters to help specify the resource you want data on (e.g., in this request, we have `id=1`).

A successful GET response will have a `200 OK` status, and should include some kind of response body - for example, HTML web content or JSON data.
Authenticates a admin user and stores the token in `admin_token`.
Authenticates a kds user and stores the token in `kds_token`.
Authenticates a cashier user and stores the token in `cashier_token`.
Authenticates a waiter user and stores the token in `waiter_token`.
Authenticates a user user and stores the token in `user_token`.
